description: CIRCUIT MECHANISMS GOVERNING ANXIOUS ANTICIPATION DURING MOTIVATIONAL CONFLICT - ANXIETY DISORDERS ARE CHARACTERIZED BY MALADAPTIVE AVOIDANCE: ANTICIPATED THREAT SUPPRESSES REWARD-SEEKING EVEN WHEN DANGER IS DISTANT, UNCERTAIN, OR ABSENT. THIS BEHAVIOR REFLECTS A FAILURE TO APPROPRIATELY ARBITRATE BETWEEN COMPETING MOTIVATIONAL SYSTEMS AS A FUNCTION OF VALUE AND TIME. WHILE SUBSTANTIAL PROGRESS HAS BEEN MADE IN IDENTIFYING THE NEURAL SUBSTRATES OF THREAT AND REWARD, THE CIRCUIT-LEVEL MECHANISMS THAT DETERMINE WHEN BEHAVIOR TRANSITIONS FROM APPROACH TO AVOIDANCE REMAIN POORLY UNDERSTOOD. CLINICAL EVIDENCE SUGGESTS THIS TRANSITION IS BIASED TOWARD PREMATURE SWITCHING IN ANXIETY, YET THE COMPUTATIONAL AND CIRCUIT MECHANISMS GOVERNING THIS BIAS REMAIN UNRESOLVED. THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO PRODUCE A CIRCUIT-LEVEL, COMPUTATIONALLY SPECIFIED ACCOUNT OF HOW ANXIOUS ANTICIPATION ALTERS THE TIMING OF APPROACH-TO-AVOIDANCE TRANSITIONS DURING MOTIVATIONAL CONFLICT. A NOVEL APPROACH–AVOIDANCE CONFLICT PARADIGM PROVIDES AN ACTIVE, TEMPORALLY PRECISE READOUT OF THE MOMENT REWARD PURSUIT IS ABANDONED. EXPERIMENTAL MANIPULATION OF REWARD MAGNITUDE, THREAT MAGNITUDE, AND TEMPORAL CONTINGENCIES ENABLE DISSOCIATION OF TEMPORAL PROXIMITY COMPUTATIONS FROM VALUATION AND ACTION THRESHOLDS. NATURAL INTER-INDIVIDUAL VARIABILITY IN C57BL/6 MICE WILL BE LEVERAGED TO IDENTIFY MECHANISMS THAT VARY ALONG A CONTINUOUS AXIS OF ANXIETY. IN AIM 1, THIS WORK WILL DISSOCIATE THE COMPUTATIONAL BASIS OF PREMATURE AVOIDANCE BY DETERMINING WHETHER EARLIER SWITCHING IN HIGH ANXIETY SUBJECTS ARISES FROM ALTERED VALUATION OR DISTORTED TEMPORAL REPRESENTATIONS OF THREAT. IN AIM 2, IT WILL IDENTIFY THE CIRCUIT MECHANISMS THAT IMPLEMENT THIS BIAS BY CHARACTERIZING HOW LIMBIC–CORTICOSTRIATAL INTERACTIONS RESHAPE MEDIAL PREFRONTAL AND DORSAL STRIATAL POPULATION DYNAMICS, AND BY TESTING WHETHER PREMATURE AVOIDANCE REFLECTS PERSISTENT INCREASE IN CORTICOLIMBIC ACTIVITY OR STRONG, TRANSIENT LIMBIC DRIVE IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO TRANSITIONS. IN AIM 3, IT WILL ESTABLISH CAUSAL SUFFICIENCY BY IMPOSING THE IDENTIFIED CIRCUIT MOTIFS IN LOW ANXIETY ANIMALS TO DETERMINE WHETHER THESE DYNAMICS ARE SUFFICIENT TO RECAPITULATE PREMATURE AVOIDANCE BEHAVIOR. TOGETHER, THESE STUDIES WILL ESTABLISH A COMPUTATIONAL AND CIRCUIT-LEVEL FRAMEWORK FOR APPROACH–AVOIDANCE ARBITRATION, DEFINE CANDIDATE INTERVENTION TARGETS, AND IDENTIFY QUANTITATIVE BIOMARKERS TRANSLATABLE TO HUMAN NEUROIMAGING MEASURES OF MALADAPTIVE AVOIDANCE.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: FEMALE PROTECTION FROM MASLD VIA BILE ACID REGULATION OF CHOLESTEROL LEVELS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT:  I AM AN ASSISTANT PROJECT SCIENTIST WITH INTEREST IN HOW HORMONE REGULATION OF METABOLIC PROCESSES CONTRIBUTES TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF LIVER DISEASES. MY LONG-TERM GOAL IS TO BECOME AN EXPERT IN SEX DIFFERENCES IN LIPID METABOLISM AND BECOME AN ACADEMIC LEADER IN CHOLESTEROL REGULATION, BILE ACID METABOLISM, DEVELOPING NOVEL RESOURCES AND RESEARCH TOOLS, AND MENTORING TOMORROW’S SCIENTISTS. I AIM TO EXPAND CURRENT UNDERSTANDING OF BILE ACID METABOLISM AND CHOLESTEROL HOMEOSTASIS IN LIVER LIPID REGULATION BY INTEGRATING THEM WITH MY INTEREST IN SEX DIFFERENCES. I WILL BE SUPPORTED BY MY PRIMARY MENTOR, DR. THOMAS VALLIM, A LEADER IN BILE ACID AND LIPID METABOLISM, ALONG WITH CO-MENTORS DR. KAREN REUE AND DR. ANDREA HEVENER, LEADERS IN SEX DIFFERENCES AND HORMONAL REGULATION OF METABOLISM. THEIR MENTORSHIP AND THE COMPLETION OF MY PROPOSED RESEARCH WILL ESTABLISH MY INDEPENDENT RESEARCH PROGRAM AND PUT ME ON PACE TO BECOME A LEADER AT THE INTERSECTION OF OUR FIELDS. THROUGH UCLA’S CLINICAL AND TRANSLATIONAL SCIENCE INSTITUTE, I WILL ACCESS TRAINING IN GRANT WRITING, MANUSCRIPT PREPARATION, AND ETHICAL RESEARCH. I WILL ALSO REFRESH MY ETHICS TRAINING AND TAKE DIDACTIC TRAINING IN BIOSTATISTICS AND SEX DIFFERENCES IN METABOLISM. WITH THE SUPPORT OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA LOS ANGELES, A RENOWNED RESEARCH CENTER, I AM WELL POSITIONED TO ADVANCE MY CAREER TO INDEPENDENCE.  MY FIVE-YEAR RESEARCH AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT PLAN WILL EXPAND MY EXPERTISE WHILE PROVIDING THE TRAINING NECESSARY TO GAIN INDEPENDENCE. MY PROJECT INVESTIGATES HOW HORMONAL REGULATION OF BILE ACID METABOLISM INFLUENCES CHOLESTEROL HOMEOSTASIS AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF METABOLIC-ASSOCIATED STEATOTIC LIVER DISEASE (MASLD), A PROGRESSIVE DISEASE DRIVEN BY HEPATIC LIPID ACCUMULATION. MASLD HAS INCREASED PREVALENCE IN MEN, BUT INCIDENCE DRASTICALLY INCREASES IN WOMEN AFTER MENOPAUSE. CHOLESTEROL, A KEY DRIVER OF CARDIOMETABOLIC DISEASE, IS NOW EMERGING AS A KEY CONTRIBUTOR TO MASLD. THE PRIMARY ROUTE OF CATABOLISM OF CHOLESTEROL IN THE LIVER IS THE SYNTHESIS OF BILE ACIDS, WHICH ALSO SERVE TO FACILITATE CHOLESTEROL ABSORPTION. USING AAV-CRISPR TOOLS I DEVELOPED, I DISRUPTED THE RATE LIMITING STEP OF BILE ACID SYNTHESIS, CYP7A1, IN MICE. WHILE MALES WERE PROTECTED FROM MASLD, FEMALES EXHIBITED SEVERE HEPATIC CHOLESTEROL ACCUMULATION WITH MASLD-LIKE FEATURES. FURTHER ANALYSIS REVEALED THAT FEMALES WERE STILL PRODUCING SUFFICIENT BILE ACIDS TO ABSORB CHOLESTEROL, WHICH THEN OVERWHELMS THE LIVER. I HYPOTHESIZE THAT FEMALE-SPECIFIC MECHANISMS REGULATING BA SYNTHESIS ARE REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN CHOLESTEROL HOMEOSTASIS AND PREVENT THE LIPID ACCUMULATION THAT LEADS TO MASLD. TO TEST THIS, I HAVE DESIGNED TWO AIMS. I WILL (1) INVESTIGATE FEMALE BILE ACID PRODUCTION FOLLOWING LOSS OF CYP7A1, AND (2) EXAMINE THE ROLE OF ESTROGEN IN MASLD PREVENTION VIA CYP7A1-MEDIATED CATABOLISM OF CHOLESTEROL. THESE STUDIES WILL REFINE OUR UNDERSTANDING OF HORMONE-DRIVEN REGULATION OF BILE ACID AND CHOLESTEROL METABOLISM IN MASLD DEVELOPMENT, FIRMLY ESTABLISH MY NICHE IN SEX DIFFERENCES RESEARCH, AND ACCELERATE MY TRANSITION TO AN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A DIGITAL SLEEP INTERVENTION FOR PRESCHOOLERS IN FOSTER CARE - PROJECT SUMMARY CHILDREN IN FOSTER CARE (FC) ARE AT RISK FOR CHRONIC HEALTH CONDITIONS, IN PART DUE TO EXPOSURE TO EARLY LIFE ADVERSITY. EARLY INTERVENTION MAY HELP REDUCE LONG-TERM HEALTH ISSUES AND THE ECONOMIC BURDEN ASSOCIATED WITH EARLY LIFE ADVERSITY, WITH THE PRESCHOOL PERIOD YIELDING A SUBSTANTIALLY LARGER RETURN ON INVESTMENT COMPARED TO INTERVENTIONS ADMINISTERED LATER IN DEVELOPMENT. A MAJOR CONTRIBUTOR TO THE DEVELOPMENT AND EXACERBATION OF CHRONIC HEALTH CONDITIONS ARE SLEEP DISTURBANCES, WHICH ARE COMMON AMONG CHILDREN IN FC, YET WIDELY ACCESSIBLE SLEEP INTERVENTIONS FOR THIS POPULATION ARE NONEXISTENT. THIS K01 PROPOSAL AIMS TO ADDRESS THIS CRITICAL GAP IN CARE THROUGH THE DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A TRAUMA-INFORMED DIGITAL PUBLIC-HEALTH-LEVEL SLEEP INTERVENTION, NURTURING SLEEP, WHICH WILL BE ADMINISTERED TO FOSTER CAREGIVERS OF YOUNG CHILDREN AGES 36-71 MONTHS. OUR INNOVATIVE APPROACH INVOLVES COLLABORATION WITH FC WORKERS AND PARENTS, AND EXPERTS IN SLEEP, TRAUMA, HEALTH, AND INTERVENTIONS IN THE CONTEXT OF FC. THE GOAL OF AIM 1 IS TO COLLABORATIVELY DEVELOP AND DIGITIZE INITIAL NURTURING SLEEP INTERVENTION CONTENT, INFORMED BY THE LITERATURE ON TRAUMA-INFORMED CARE, EVIDENCE-BASED STRATEGIES TO SUPPORT HEALTHY SLEEP, FC LICENSING REGULATIONS, AND FOSTER PARENT NEEDS AND EXPERIENCES. IN AIM 2, NURTURING SLEEP WILL BE PRETESTED BY FOSTER CAREGIVERS WHO WILL PROVIDE QUALITATIVE FEEDBACK ON THE INTERVENTION, WHICH WILL BE USED TO MAKE FINAL INTERVENTION MODIFICATIONS. AIM 3 WILL EVALUATE WHETHER NURTURING SLEEP IS ASSOCIATED WITH IMPROVEMENTS IN FOSTER CAREGIVER BEHAVIORS AROUND SLEEP, AND IN CHILD SLEEP FROM PRE TO POST INTERVENTION, AND AT A 3-MONTH FOLLOW-UP. THIS WILL BE THE FIRST LARGE SCALE SLEEP INTERVENTION DEVELOPED AND TESTED IN THIS POPULATION. LOCAL AND NATIONAL STAKEHOLDERS HAVE EXPRESSED ENTHUSIASM AND HAVE COMMITTED TO INVOLVEMENT IN THE DEVELOPMENT, IMPLEMENTATION, AND EVALUATION OF NURTURING SLEEP. TO ACHIEVE THE RESEARCH PLAN, THE PI WILL EXECUTE A STRUCTURED COMPREHENSIVE TRAINING PLAN TO GAIN SPECIALIZED SKILLS IN (1) SLEEP, MENTAL HEALTH, AND ADVERSITY IN EARLY CHILDHOOD IN THE CONTEXT OF FC, (2) DEVELOPING PARTNERSHIPS WITH THE CHILD WELFARE COMMUNITY, (3) INTERVENTION DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION SCIENCE, (4) IMPLEMENTATION AND DISSEMINATION OF DIGITAL INTERVENTIONS, AND (5) DESIGNING, CONDUCTING, AND ANALYZING CLINICAL TRIALS. TRAINING WILL BE OVERSEEN BY AN OUTSTANDING MENTORSHIP TEAM WITH CROSS-CUTTING EXPERTISE IN THESE AREAS AND A TRACK RECORD OF SUCCESSFUL MENTORSHIP EXPERIENCES AND COLLABORATIONS. IMPLEMENTATION OF THE RESEARCH AND TRAINING PLANS WILL ALSO BE BOLSTERED BY SUPPORT FROM THE INSTITUTIONAL ENVIRONMENT, NAMELY BRADLEY HOSPITAL, BROWN MEDICAL SCHOOL, AND TWO MAJOR CENTER GRANTS FOCUSED ON PROMOTING THE CAREER DEVELOPMENT OF EARLY-STAGE INVESTIGATORS IN 1) CHILDHOOD STRESS, TRAUMA, AND RESILIENCE, AND 2) SLEEP AND CIRCADIAN RHYTHMS IN CHILD AND ADOLESCENT MENTAL HEALTH. THIS AWARD WILL CATAPULT PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR DR. DARLYNN ROJO-WISSAR’S TRANSITION TO AN INDEPENDENT TRANSLATIONAL SCIENTIST WITH A CAREER HIGH IN SCIENTIFIC AND PUBLIC HEALTH IMPACT IN EARLY LIFE ADVERSITY, SLEEP, AND HEALTH.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: USE OF ANTENATAL DISEASE MODIFYING ANTIRHEUMATIC DRUGS AND MATERNAL-CHILD HEALTH AMONG WOMEN WITH CHRONIC INFLAMMATORY ARTHRITIS - ABSTRACT RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, AXIAL SPONDYLOARTHRITIS, AND PSORIATIC ARTHRITIS- COLLECTIVELY KNOWN AS CHRONIC INFLAMMATORY ARTHRITIS (CIA), AFFECT 4% OF THE U.S POPULATION. PREGNANCY IS A UNIQUE SITUATION FOR WOMEN WITH CIA, PUTTING THEM AT ALMOST TRIPLE THE RISK OF ADVERSE PREGNANCY OUTCOMES, COMPARED TO THE GENERAL POPULATION. DESPITE GUIDELINES RECOMMENDING CONTINUED USE OF PREGNANCY-COMPATIBLE DISEASE MODIFYING ANTIRHEUMATIC DRUGS (DMARDS) TO CONTROL INFLAMMATION, ALMOST TWO-THIRDS OF PREGNANT WOMEN WITH RHEUMATIC DISEASES DISCONTINUE THERAPY DUE TO CONCERNS ABOUT FETAL SAFETY. WE DO NOT KNOW HOW THIS MAY IMPACT THEIR CHILDREN’S LONG-TERM HEALTH. THIS K08 PROPOSAL WILL PROVIDE CRITICAL EVIDENCE ON WHETHER ADHERING TO DMARDS DURING DIFFERENT STAGES OF PREGNANCY YIELDS BETTER OUTCOMES FOR MOTHERS WITH CIA AND THEIR CHILDREN THAN NONADHERENCE. I AM A BOARD-CERTIFIED RHEUMATOLOGIST AND HOLD A MASTER OF PUBLIC HEALTH DEGREE. MY LONG-TERM GOAL IS TO LEAD AN INDEPENDENT RESEARCH PROGRAM THAT HARNESSES REAL-WORLD EVIDENCE AND INNOVATIVE EPIDEMIOLOGIC TECHNIQUES TO GENERATE ACTIONABLE EVIDENCE TO IMPROVE MATERNAL-CHILD HEALTH OUTCOMES AMONG INDIVIDUALS WITH RHEUMATIC DISEASES. ALTHOUGH I HAVE A STRONG CLINICAL BACKGROUND AND TRAINING IN EPIDEMIOLOGY, I REQUIRE ADDITIONAL SKILLS IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS TO ACHIEVE MY LONG-TERM GOALS: (1) PROFICIENCY IN PERINATAL AND PHARMACOEPIDEMIOLOGIC METHODS TO ANALYZE AND INTERPRET DATA FROM LONGITUDINAL MATERNAL-CHILD COHORTS; (2) EXPERTISE IN COHORT STUDY DESIGN, PATIENT RECRUITMENT, AND DATA COLLECTION; AND (3) COMPETENCIES IN TEAM LEADERSHIP AND COLLABORATION. I HAVE CREATED A MULTIDISCIPLINARY MENTORSHIP TEAM AND CURATED A RIGOROUS CAREER DEVELOPMENT PLAN. MY PROPOSED K08 PROJECT WILL MEET THE TRAINING AIMS IN THE FOLLOWING WAYS: IN THE FIRST AND SECOND AIMS, WE WILL EXAMINE WHETHER DMARD ADHERENCE AT DIFFERENT TRIMESTERS OF PREGNANCY AFFECTS MATERNAL-CHILD HEALTH OUTCOMES AMONG PREGNANT WOMEN WITH CIA. I WILL HARNESS THE STRENGTHS OF US HEALTHCARE ADMINISTRATIVE CLAIMS DATA (MEDICAID) AND DANISH CLINICAL REGISTRIES TO ACHIEVE THE GOAL (TOTAL SAMPLE SIZE OF ~40,000 PREGNANCIES OF WOMEN WITH CIA). THESE DATABASES HAVE COMPLEMENTARY STRENGTHS. MEDICAID FINANCES ABOUT HALF OF ALL PREGNANCIES IN THE US, MAKING IT ONE OF THE LARGEST DATABASES TO STUDY PREGNANCY OUTCOMES ACROSS DIVERSE POPULATIONS. THE DANISH CLINICAL REGISTRIES PROVIDE LONGITUDINAL, PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL DATA ON WOMEN WITH CIA AND THEIR OFFSPRING, ALONG WITH DISEASE ACTIVITY MEASURES DURING PREGNANCY. IN THE THIRD AIM, I WILL DEVELOP A PROSPECTIVE COHORT STUDY OF WOMEN WITH CIA BY RECRUITING THEM DURING EARLY PREGNANCY AND CONDUCTING LONGITUDINAL FOLLOW-UPS OF THEIR PREGNANCIES AND OFFSPRING. description: THERAPEUTIC GENE EDITING NANOPARTICLES FOR SICKLE CELL DISEASE - ABSTRACT THE CURE OF BLOOD DISEASES, SUCH AS SICKLE CELL DISEASE (SCD), REQUIRES USING HEALTHY DONOR (ALLOGENEIC) HEMATOPOIETIC STEM CELLS (HSC) OR GENETICALLY MODIFIED SELF-HSC. TOXIC CHEMOTHERAPY OR RADIATION (I.E., CONDITIONING) IS REQUIRED TO DEPLETE EXISTING STEM CELLS AND MAKE SPACE FOR NEW CELLS. IF THE DONOR IMMUNE SYSTEM (GRAFT) IS NOT MATCHED TO THE RECIPIENT (HOST), POTENTIALLY FATAL GRAFT-VERSUS-HOST DISEASE (GVHD) WILL DEVELOP. THERE IS APPROXIMATELY A 10% MORTALITY RATE FROM CONDITIONING AND GVHD IN THE FIRST 100 DAYS AFTER HSC TRANSPLANTATION (HSCT). THIS MEANS THAT THOSE WHO CAN ACCESS ALLOGENEIC HSCT ARE LIMITED TO HEALTH-CARE INTENSIVE COUNTRIES AND TRADITIONALLY MUST HAVE A MATCHED DONOR, WHICH IS ONLY ~30% FOR CERTAIN U.S. GROUPS. GENE THERAPY, I.E., THE PERSONALIZED CORRECTION OF ONE’S OWN CELLS, CURRENTLY UTILIZES EX VIVO VIRAL TRANSDUCTION OR ELECTROPORATION OF HSC. THIS THEN REQUIRES CONDITIONING TO REMOVE THE DISEASED HSCS THAT REMAIN IN THE BODY BEFORE GENE CORRECTED CELLS CAN BE RETURNED. CURRENT GENE THERAPY UTILIZES SUBOPTIMAL METHODS, VIRAL VECTORS OR ELECTROPORATION, THAT CAUSE CELL TOXICITY AND DELAYED ENGRAFTMENT. >10% OF PATIENTS CANNOT PROVIDE ENOUGH HSC FOR THE CURRENT CLUSTERED REGULARLY INTERSPACED SHORT PALINDROMIC REPEATS (CRISPR)-CAS9-BASED GENE THERAPY FOR SCD. THE LONG-TERM OBJECTIVE OF DEVELOPING NON-VIRAL PLATFORMS FOR LESS TOXIC DELIVERY TO HSC IS THUS CRITICAL FOR CREATING A NEW CLASS OF GENETIC MEDICINES FOR BLOOD DISORDERS. TO DO THIS, NANOPARTICLE (NP)-MEDIATED DELIVERY OF CRISPR-CAS9 WILL BE EXPLORED. IN PRELIMINARY STUDIES, DR. TRIEBWASSER HAS SHOWN THAT POLY(BETA-AMINO ESTER) (PBAE) POLYMERIC NP CARRYING CAS9 CAN EFFICIENTLY EDIT PRIMARY HUMAN HEMATOPOIETIC STEM AND PROGENITOR CELLS (HSPC, CD34+ CELLS) WITH REDUCED TOXICITY COMPARED TO ELECTROPORATION AND WITHOUT AFFECTING ERYTHROPOIESIS. THE CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS IS THAT PBAE CAS9 NP GENE EDITING OF HSC HAS REDUCED TOXICITY COMPARED TO EXISTING METHODS (I.E., ELECTROPORATION). IN THIS GRANT, DR. TRIEBWASSER WILL DEEPLY CHARACTERIZE THE PHENOTYPE AND NUMBER OF STEM AND PROGENITOR CELL SUBSETS THAT ARE EDITED BY PBAE NP USING FLOW CYTOMETRY AND SINGLE CELL RNA-SEQ. THE FUNCTION OF GENE-EDITED STEM CELLS WILL BE ASSESSED WITH COLONY FORMING ASSAYS AND XENOTRANSPLANTATION (SA1). THE ABILITY OF THIS NP PLATFORM TO GENE EDIT CD34+ CELLS FROM PATIENTS WITH SCD AT THE CLINICALLY VALIDATED BCL11A +58 ERYTHROID ENHANCER FOR GAMMA-GLOBIN REACTIVATION WILL BE ASSESSED IN VITRO AND IN VIVO (SA2). FINALLY, CHEMICAL VARIANTS OF THIS EFFECTIVE POLYMERIC NANOPARTICLE WILL BE STUDIED FOR IMPROVED EFFICACY AND STABILITY (SA3), WITH IN VIVO STUDIES IN THE FUTURE. BY COMPLETING THIS EXPERIMENTAL WORK UNDER THE GUIDANCE OF HIS MENTORS AND ADVISORY TEAM AND PURSUING RELEVANT COURSEWORK, DR. TRIEBWASSER WILL GAIN THE SKILLS NEEDED (PHENOTYPIC AND FUNCTIONAL CHARACTERIZATION OF GENE EDITED HSC, ASSESSMENT OF ERYTHROPOIESIS AND GLOBIN SWITCHING, NP SYNTHESIS AND CHARACTERIZATION, TRAINING IN FUNDING ACQUISITION, AND LABORATORY MANAGEMENT) TO SUCCEED AS AN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR. AFTER THIS K08 PERIOD, DR. TRIEBWASSER WILL BE WELL-POSITIONED TO LEAD THE APPLICATION OF NANOMEDICINE-BASED GENE THERAPY TO HEMATOPOIETIC DISEASES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SCD.

description: DETECTING MALIGNANCY AND TREATMENT RESPONSE IN NF1-PERIPHERAL NERVE SHEATH TUMORS THROUGH CFDNA FRAGMENTOMICS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT MALIGNANT PERIPHERAL NERVE SHEATH TUMORS (MPNSTS) ARE AGGRESSIVE MALIGNANCIES AND THE LEADING CAUSE OF MORTALITY AMONG INDIVIDUALS WITH NEUROFIBROMATOSIS TYPE 1 (NF1), A COMMON GENETIC DISORDER AFFECTING APPROXIMATELY 1 IN 2,500 PEOPLE. MPNSTS OFTEN ARISE FROM PRE-EXISTING PLEXIFORM NEUROFIBROMAS (PNS), YET CLINICALLY IDENTIFYING THIS MALIGNANT TRANSFORMATION REMAINS DIFFICULT. AS A RESULT, TUMORS ARE LARGE AT PRESENTATION, TREATMENT OPTIONS ARE LIMITED, AND SURVIVAL OUTCOMES ARE POOR. THE OVERARCHING GOAL OF THIS RESEARCH IS TO DEVELOP NONINVASIVE CELL-FREE DNA (CFDNA) BIOMARKERS FOR EARLY DETECTION AND TREATMENT MONITORING OF NF1-ASSOCIATED MPNSTS. THE CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS IS THAT INTEGRATED CFDNA EPIGENOMIC FEATURES CAN DETECT MALIGNANT TRANSFORMATION AND TRACK TREATMENT RESPONSE EARLIER AND MORE SPECIFICALLY THAN CURRENT CLINICAL TOOLS. THIS WORK WILL LEVERAGE CFDNA METHYLATION PATTERNS AND INFERRED NUCLEOSOME POSITIONING, WHICH REFLECT THE TUMOR’S EPIGENETIC STATE AND GENE EXPRESSION. A CFDNA MALIGNANCY RISK SCORE WILL QUANTIFY MALIGNANT POTENTIAL ACROSS THE FULL SPECTRUM OF PERIPHERAL NERVE SHEATH TUMORS (PNSTS) FROM BENIGN PN TO MPNST. IN PARALLEL, PATIENT-DERIVED XENOGRAFT (PDX) MODELS WILL BE USED TO RELATE CFDNA TRAJECTORIES FROM SERIAL NONTERMINAL SAMPLES TO TUMOR GROWTH AND PATHWAY ACTIVITY DURING TARGETED THERAPY, PROVIDING A FRAMEWORK FOR MONITORING TREATMENT RESPONSE AND RESISTANCE IN REAL TIME. THE CANDIDATE’S CAREER DEVELOPMENT PLAN IS DESIGNED TO ESTABLISH HIM AS AN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR LEADING A CFDNA RESEARCH PROGRAM FOR NF1 AND RELATED HEREDITARY CANCER SYNDROMES. UNDER THE MENTORSHIP OF DR. AADEL CHAUDHURI, AN EXPERT IN CFDNA ANALYSIS, AND OTHER LEADERS IN PRECLINICAL MODELING AND TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH, HE WILL RECEIVE TARGETED TRAINING IN CFDNA FRAGMENTOMICS AND EPIGENOMICS, PDX MODELING, ADVANCED BIOINFORMATICS, AND CLINICAL TRIAL DESIGN. THE MAYO CLINIC ENVIRONMENT, WITH STRONG INFRASTRUCTURE FOR GENOMIC ANALYSIS AND CLINICAL ASSAY DEVELOPMENT, WILL SUPPORT BOTH HIS SCIENTIFIC GROWTH AND THE SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THE PROPOSED STUDIES. BY ADVANCING NONINVASIVE CFDNA DIAGNOSTICS AND TREATMENT MONITORING FOR NF1-ASSOCIATED MPNSTS, THIS WORK ADDRESSES A CRITICAL UNMET NEED: TIMELY DETECTION AND EFFECTIVE MONITORING OF MALIGNANT TRANSFORMATION AND TREATMENT RESPONSE IN A HIGH-RISK POPULATION. IMPROVED EARLY DETECTION AND PRECISE MONITORING HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO SIGNIFICANTLY ENHANCE OUTCOMES AND SURVIVAL FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH NF1, IN ALIGNMENT WITH THE MISSION TO REDUCE THE BURDEN OF NEUROLOGICAL DISEASE.

description: ELUCIDATING THE MECHANISMS OF MRE11-MEDIATED CGAS ACTIVATION IN DNA SENSING: MECHANISMS OF CGAS ACTIVATION - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT  THE CGAS-STING PATHWAY PLAYS A CRUCIAL ROLE IN INITIATING THE INNATE IMMUNE RESPONSE BY RECOGNIZING CYTOSOLIC DOUBLE-STRANDED DNA (DSDNA) RESULTING FROM ONCOGENE-INDUCED DNA DAMAGE, LEADING TO THE ELIMINATION OF DAMAGED OR CANCEROUS CELLS. MRE11, A DNA REPAIR PROTEIN, FACILITATES THE RELEASE OF CGAS FROM CHROMATIN, ENABLING IT TO DETECT CYTOSOLIC DSDNA OR MICRONUCLEAR (MN) DNA AND ACTIVATE THE STING PATHWAY. HOWEVER, THE MECHANISMS BY WHICH MRE11 MEDIATES CGAS RELEASE AND HOW CGAS RECOGNIZES AND RESPONDS TO DSDNA AND MN REMAIN UNCLEAR. RECENT STUDIES SUGGEST THAT NUCLEAR ENVELOPE RUPTURE ALONE IS INSUFFICIENT FOR CGAS RECRUITMENT TO MN, AND HISTONE MODIFICATIONS SUCH AS H3K79ME2 PLAY A CRUCIAL ROLE IN CGAS ACTIVATION WITHIN MN. THE GOAL OF THIS STUDY IS TO DETERMINE HOW CGAS IS RELEASED AND ACTIVATED BY MRE11 AND TO IDENTIFY OTHER INTERACTING PROTEINS THAT CLARIFY THE MECHANISMS OF MRE11-MEDIATED CGAS ACTIVATION. AIM 1 FOCUSES ON HOW SPECIFIC HISTONE MODIFICATIONS, SUCH AS H3K79ME2 AND H3K27AC, INFLUENCE CGAS RELEASE FROM CHROMATIN THROUGH INTERACTIONS WITH MRE11, FACILITATING ITS RELOCATION TO CYTOSOLIC DSDNA AND MN. WE WILL UTILIZE HISTONE METHYLATION INHIBITORS, SIRNA, AND CRISPR/CAS9-BASED GENE KNOCKDOWN OR CHROMATIN IMMUNOPRECIPITATION (CHIP) ASSAYS TO INVESTIGATE THIS, ALONGSIDE IN VITRO EXPERIMENTS WITH MODIFIED NUCLEOSOMES TO ASSESS THE BINDING AFFINITY BETWEEN MRE11 AND CGAS. AIM 2 INVESTIGATES WHETHER ADDITIONAL REGULATORY STEPS ARE REQUIRED FOR FULL CGAS ACTIVATION, BUILDING ON PREVIOUS DATA THAT SUGGEST CYTOPLASMIC TRANSLOCATION AND DSDNA SENSING ALONE ARE INSUFFICIENT. WE WILL USE R255A MUTANTS AND CGAS VARIANTS WITH NUCLEAR LOCALIZATION SIGNALS (NLS) OR NUCLEAR EXPORT SIGNALS (NES) TO EXPLORE MECHANISMS REQUIRED FOR STING PATHWAY ACTIVATION. AIM 3 INVOLVES CREATING STABLE CELL LINES EXPRESSING BIOID2-TAGGED CGAS AND MRE11 TO MAP THEIR INTERACTION NETWORKS AND IDENTIFY PROTEINS INVOLVED IN CGAS-MRE11 INTERACTIONS THROUGH PROTEOMICS. IDENTIFIED PROTEINS WILL BE ASSESSED FOR THEIR ROLES IN MODULATING CGAS ACTIVATION AND DOWNSTREAM SIGNALING, REVEALING POTENTIAL THERAPEUTIC TARGETS. THIS STUDY AIMS TO ELUCIDATE THE MOLECULAR MECHANISMS OF CGAS-STING PATHWAY-MEDIATED TUMOR SUPPRESSION, POTENTIALLY OFFERING NEW THERAPEUTIC STRATEGIES TO ENHANCE IMMUNE RESPONSES IN CANCER.

description: BOOSTING AUD TREATMENT BY TARGETING HIGH-RISK DRINKING DAYS WITH AI-GENERATED CBT CONTENT - ABSTRACT ALCOHOL USE DISORDER (AUD) IS A MAJOR PUBLIC HEALTH PROBLEM IN THE U.S., CONTRIBUTING TO OVER 100,000 DEATHS AND BILLIONS OF DOLLARS IN ECONOMIC LOSSES EACH YEAR. FEWER THAN 10% OF PEOPLE WITH AUD RECEIVE TREATMENT ANNUALLY DUE TO COST, STIGMA, AND LOGISTICAL CHALLENGES; LINGUISTIC AND CULTURAL DIFFERENCES FURTHER LIMIT ACCESS FOR U.S. COMMUNITIES THAT PRIMARILY SPEAK A LANGUAGE OTHER THAN ENGLISH (E.G., SPANISH). MANY OF THESE CHALLENGES CAN BE ADDRESSED BY EVIDENCE-BASED DIGITAL INTERVENTIONS, SINCE >90% OF THE U.S. POPULATION OWNS A SMARTPHONE. YET MANY DIGITAL INTERVENTIONS FAIL TO SUSTAIN PATIENTS’ ENGAGEMENT OVER TIME. THIS PROJECT WILL APPLY INNOVATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) AGENTS TO AUTONOMOUSLY GENERATE HIGHLY ENGAGING, MULTIMEDIA COGNITIVE BEHAVIORAL THERAPY (CBT) CONTENT TAILORED FOR ENGLISH SPEAKERS AND SPANISH SPEAKERS. THE GOAL OF THE NEW DIGITAL CONTENT WILL BE TO PROVIDE CONDENSED CBT SKILLS TRAINING VIA PATIENTS’ PHONES TO SPECIFICALLY TARGET PERIODS OF HIGH RISK FOR DRINKING (E.G., WEEKENDS). UNLIKE CONVENTIONAL APPROACHES TO DEVELOPING DIGITAL CONTENT, AI AGENTS CAN RAPIDLY CREATE NEW CONTENT TO MATCH PATIENTS’ NEEDS AND CONTEXT (E.G., LANGUAGE PREFERENCE; ENVIRONMENT), OFFERING A SCALABLE SOLUTION TO IMPROVE ENGAGEMENT WITH DIGITAL INTERVENTIONS FOR AUD. AI AGENTS CAN ALSO EFFICIENTLY GENERATE NEW CONTENT BY LEARNING FROM EXISTING DIGITAL PROGRAMS FOR AUD, SUCH AS COMPUTER BASED TRAINING FOR COGNITIVE BEHAVIORAL THERAPY (CBT4CBT-A), WHICH HAS DEMONSTRATED EFFICACY IN 3 RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIALS, INCLUDING A TRIAL WITH ONLY SPANISH-SPEAKING PATIENTS. BUT CBT4CBT-A IS NOT DESIGNED FOR EASY AND RAPID MOBILE USE DURING PERIODS OF HIGH RISK FOR DRINKING, AS EACH PROGRAM MODULE TAKES ~35 MINUTES TO COMPLETE AND IS STRUCTURED FOR PERSONAL COMPUTERS. TO DEVELOP AI AGENTS THAT GENERATE ENGAGING CONTENT TO ENHANCE PATIENTS’ PRACTICE OF CBT SKILLS ON DAYS OF HIGH RISK FOR DRINKING, THE FOLLOWING RESEARCH AIMS WILL BE PURSUED: 1) DEVELOP AI AGENTS THAT GENERATE MULTIMEDIA CBT CONTENT TO SUPPLEMENT AUD TREATMENT; 2) EVALUATE THE FEASIBILITY OF INTERACTING WITH AI-GENERATED CBT CONTENT ON THE WEEKENDS; 3) ESTIMATE THE EFFECT OF AI- GENERATED CBT CONTENT ON ALCOHOL USE AND PSYCHIATRIC SYMPTOMS. TO ACHIEVE THESE AIMS, MY CAREER DEVELOPMENT PLAN INCLUDES MENTORED TRAINING IN THE FOLLOWING DOMAINS: DEVELOPING AI AGENTS TO GENERATE AUD TREATMENT CONTENT; DIRECTING A CLINICAL TRIAL OF A TREATMENT FOR AUD; USING INNOVATIVE STATISTICAL METHODS TO ANALYZE CLINICAL TRIAL ENDPOINTS; FOSTERING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT THROUGH GRANT WRITING, PUBLISHING, LEADERSHIP, AND NETWORKING. TRAINING ACTIVITIES INCLUDE ACADEMIC COURSEWORK, AN NIH- SPONSORED TRAINING PROGRAM, APPLIED WORKSHOPS, AND ANNUAL SYMPOSIUMS/CONFERENCES. THESE ACTIVITIES BUILD ON MY PRIOR TRAINING IN ADDICTION TREATMENT, CLINICAL RESEARCH, QUALITATIVE METHODS, CULTURALLY-ADAPTED INTERVENTIONS, MOBILE TECHNOLOGY, AND ADVANCED STATISTICS. THIS AWARD WILL POSITION ME TO LEAD A NEW GENERATION OF AI-DRIVEN DIGITAL INTERVENTIONS THAT CAN IMPROVE TREATMENTS AND EXPAND ACCESS FOR ALL PEOPLE IN THE U.S. WITH AUD.

description: QUANTITATIVE CHEST IMAGING AND SERUM PROTEOMICS IN PATIENTS WITH SYSTEMIC AUTOIMMUNE RHEUMATIC DISEASE-ASSOCIATED INTERSTITIAL LUNG DISEASE - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT SYSTEMIC AUTOIMMUNE RHEUMATIC DISEASE-ASSOCIATED INTERSTITIAL LUNG DISEASE (SARD-ILD, ALSO KNOWN AS CONNECTIVE TISSUE DISEASE-ASSOCIATED ILD) IS A MAJOR DRIVER OF MORBIDITY, MORTALITY, AND HEALTHCARE COSTS IN PATIENTS WITH AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE AND ACCOUNTS FOR 30% OF ALL PATIENTS WITH ILD. RECENT ADVANCES IN IMMUNOSUPPRESSIVE AND ANTIFIBROTIC TREATMENT OPTIONS HAVE EMPHASIZED THE IMPORTANCE OF EARLY DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT OF SARD-ILD. MACHINE LEARNING-DERIVED QUANTITATIVE COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY (QCT) ANALYSIS OF CHEST IMAGING AND SERUM PROTEOMICS OFFER SIGNIFICANT PROMISE FOR IDENTIFYING SARD-ILD PATIENTS AT HIGH RISK OF DISEASE PROGRESSION AND POOR OUTCOMES, BUT HAVE NOT BEEN EXTENSIVELY EVALUATED IN SARD-ILD. THIS 5-YEAR K23 PATIENT-ORIENTED RESEARCH CAREER DEVELOPMENT AWARD ADDRESSES THIS RESEARCH GAP BY: 1) EXAMINING ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN QCT FEATURES PRESENT AT DIAGNOSIS AND MORTALITY IN PATIENTS WITH RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS- ASSOCIATED ILD (RA-ILD), 2) IDENTIFYING SERUM PROTEOMIC PROFILES OF PATIENTS WITH FIBROTIC RA-ILD AT HIGH RISK OF PROGRESSION, AND 3) EXPANDING THE SERUM PROTEOMIC FINDINGS TO PATIENTS WITH OTHER FORMS OF FIBROTIC AND NONFIBROTIC SARD-ILD. THIS INNOVATIVE PROJECT WILL GENERATE IMPORTANT CLINICAL INSIGHTS ABOUT THE USE OF QCT AND SERUM PROTEOMICS TO IDENTIFY SARD-ILD PATIENTS AT HIGH RISK OF DISEASE PROGRESSION. FURTHERMORE, THE CORRESPONDING TRAINING PLAN WILL SUPPORT DR. GREGORY MCDERMOTT, INSTRUCTOR IN MEDICINE AND ATTENDING RHEUMATOLOGIST AT BRIGHAM AND WOMEN'S HOSPITAL (BWH), IN BECOMING AN INDEPENDENT CLINICAL INVESTIGATOR STUDYING APPROACHES TO IMPROVE EARLY DETECTION, TREATMENT, AND OUTCOMES FOR PATIENTS WITH SARD-ILD. TRAINING IN THREE AREAS WILL SUPPORT DR. MCDERMOTT'S TRANSITION TO RESEARCH INDEPENDENCE: 1) GENERATION AND INVESTIGATION OF MACHINE LEARNING QCT IMAGING DATA, 2) DERIVATION AND ANALYSIS OF SERUM PROTEOMICS DATA, AND, 3) PROSPECTIVE PATIENT RECRUITMENT TECHNIQUES. A MULTIDISCIPLINARY MENTORSHIP TEAM CONSISTING OF RHEUMATOLOGISTS, PULMONOLOGISTS, AND BIOSTATISTICIANS WILL OVERSEE DR. MCDERMOTT'S TRAINING: DR. JEFFREY SPARKS (PRIMARY MENTOR); DRS. GEORGE WASHKO, KATHERINE LIAO, AND MICHAEL CHO (CO-MENTORS); AND DRS. PUI LEE, SUZANNE BYRNE, AND MISTI PAUDEL (SIGNIFICANT CONTRIBUTORS). DR. MCDERMOTT HAS A COMMITMENT FROM HIS DIVISION FOR AT LEAST 75% PROTECTED TIME FOR RESEARCH AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT ACTIVITIES DURING THE K23 AWARD PERIOD AND WILL COMPLETE FOCUSED COURSEWORK IN `OMICS RESEARCH, SURVIVAL ANALYSIS METHODS, AND MACHINE LEARNING TO FACILITATE HIS PATH TO INDEPENDENCE. THE BWH DIVISION OF RHEUMATOLOGY AND SECTION OF CLINICAL SCIENCES WILL PROVIDE RESOURCES AND EXPERTISE FOR THE PROPOSED STUDIES. SUPPORT FROM THE DIVISION AND HIS PRIMARY MENTOR'S RESEARCH FUNDS WILL SUPPLEMENT HIS SALARY AND PROJECT-RELATED EXPENSES. THE PROPOSED PROJECT AND TRAINING WILL INFORM PREPARATION OF A FUTURE R01 APPLICATION TO APPLY QCT AND SERUM PROTEOMICS TECHNIQUES TO ENABLE EARLY IDENTIFICATION AND INITIATION OF DISEASE MODIFYING TREATMENTS IN SARD-ILD PATIENTS.

description: A COMMUNITY-BASED PRODUCE PRESCRIPTION INTERVENTION TO IMPROVE NUTRITION SECURITY IN POPULATIONS WITH NUTRITION INSECURITY AND OBESITY. - PROJECT ABSTRACT: HEALTH DISPARITIES INCLUDING SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS, HEALTH INSURANCE STATUS, AND ACCESS TO HEALTH CARE, TO NAME A FEW, HAVE A SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON HEALTH AND DISEASE. NUTRITION INSECURITY IS A MAJOR FACTOR FOR OBESITY WHICH IS DEFINED AS INDIVIDUALS NOT HAVING CONSISTENT ACCESS TO AFFORDABLE, HEALTHY, AND SAFE FOODS WHICH ARE ESSENTIAL FOR HEALTH. THIS IS OF PARTICULAR RELEVANCE FOR PATIENTS IN URBAN SETTINGS.  BASED ON A NEEDS ASSESSMENT OF OVER 1000 PATIENTS FROM FIVE SAFETY NET URBAN CLINICS IN PROVIDENCE, RHODE ISLAND, INCLUDING THE STUDY SITE FOR THIS PROPOSED RESEARCH, ALMOST HALF OF THE PATIENTS (47%) REPORTED REGULARLY REDUCING MEALS OR PORTION SIZES DUE TO A LACK OF FOOD.  NOVEL NUTRITION INTERVENTION EFFORTS ARE NEEDED TO ADDRESS THESE IMPORTANT HEALTH DISPARITIES TO INCREASE ACCESS AND AFFORDABILITY OF FRUITS AND VEGETABLES IN ORDER TO COMBAT OBESITY AND IMPROVE NUTRITION SECURITY, WHICH IS THE KEY PREMISE BEHIND THIS PROPOSED RESEARCH. TO ADDRESS THIS, THE SPECIFIC AIMS OF THIS PROPOSAL ARE TO 1) CONDUCT FOCUS GROUPS TO EXPLORE THE ACCEPTABILITY AND FEASIBILITY OF A PRODUCE PRESCRIPTION PROGRAM (PPR) WITH PATIENT AND HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS IN AN URBAN CLINIC; 2) PERFORM AN OPEN PILOT OF A PPR INTERVENTION FOCUSED ON PROGRAM UTILIZATION IN 10-15 PATIENTS WITH OBESITY AND NUTRITION INSECURITY; AND 3) CONDUCT A PILOT RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIAL (RCT) TO EVALUATE THE IMPACT OF A PPR INTERVENTION ON PRODUCE CONSUMPTION AND CLINICALLY RELEVANT HEALTH OUTCOMES. THE FINDINGS FROM THE PROPOSED RESEARCH WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF NOVEL AND MUCH NEEDED APPROACHES TO IMPROVE PRODUCE CONSUMPTION IN POPULATIONS IMPACTED BY OBESITY AND NUTRITION INSECURITY. THE PROPOSAL WILL SUPPORT THE MENTORING AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE PI TO BECOME AN INDEPENDENTLY FUNDED PHYSICIAN SCIENTIST WHO SPECIALIZES IN IMPLEMENTATION OF COMMUNITY-BASED INTERVENTIONS TO IMPROVE HEALTHY EATING AND REDUCE THE IMPACT OF NONCOMMUNICABLE DIETARY RELATED DISEASES IN POPULATIONS MOST IMPACTED BY OBESITY AND NUTRITION INSECURITY.  THE PROPOSED RESEARCH BUILDS UPON THE EXPECTATIONAL RESOURCES AND MENTORSHIP PROVIDED AT THE WARREN ALPERT MEDICAL SCHOOL OF BROWN UNIVERSITY AND RHODE ISLAND HOSPITAL, ALONG WITH OTHER INSTITUTIONS TO PROVIDE THE PI WITH TRAINING IN KEY NEW AREAS OF RESEARCH, ENHANCE APPLICATIONS FOR COMPETITIVE GRANT FUNDING, PROVIDE UNIQUE COLLABORATION OPPORTUNITIES, AND BUILD THE NECESSARY FOUNDATION TO ATTAIN RESEARCH INDEPENDENCE.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: BRIDGING THE GUT-BRAIN CONNECTION: A NOVEL INTEGRATED APPROACH TO ESOPHAGEAL SYMPTOM PERCEPTION - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT GASTROESOPHAGEAL REFLUX DISEASE (GERD) IS A HIGHLY PREVALENT ESOPHAGEAL CONDITION, AFFECTING 20–30% OF U.S. ADULTS, AND CAUSES SYMPTOMS SUCH AS HEARTBURN, REGURGITATION, AND CHEST PAIN. ALTHOUGH FIRST-LINE ACID SUPPRESSING THERAPIES EFFECTIVELY REDUCE STOMACH ACID, UP TO 40% OF PATIENTS CONTINUE TO EXPERIENCE PERSISTENT, REFRACTORY SYMPTOMS. RESEARCH INDICATES THAT MOST SYMPTOMS ARE NOT DIRECTLY LINKED TO ACID REFLUX EVENTS. INSTEAD, ESOPHAGEAL SYMPTOM PERCEPTION IS INCREASINGLY RECOGNIZED AS MULTIFACTORIAL, ARISING FROM DYNAMIC INTERACTIONS BETWEEN PERIPHERAL (GUT) AND CENTRAL (BRAIN) PROCESSES ALONG THE BIDIRECTIONAL GUT-BRAIN AXIS. THUS, ADDRESSING ACID REFLUX ALONE IS OFTEN INSUFFICIENT WHEN CENTRAL FACTORS, SUCH AS PSYCHOLOGICAL PROCESSES, ALSO CONTRIBUTE. PSYCHOLOGICAL PROCESSES, SUCH AS ESOPHAGEAL HYPERVIGILANCE AND SYMPTOM-SPECIFIC ANXIETY HAVE BEEN SHOWN TO SIGNIFICANTLY AND INDEPENDENTLY INFLUENCE GERD SYMPTOM SEVERITY. HOWEVER, RESEARCH HAS RELIED ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY ON RETROSPECTIVE QUESTIONNAIRES AND CROSS-SECTIONAL DESIGNS, LIMITING OUR UNDERSTANDING OF HOW PSYCHOLOGICAL PROCESSES DRIVE SYMPTOMS BOTH ON THEIR OWN AND THROUGH THEIR INTERACTION WITH PHYSIOLOGY. THIS K23 PROPOSAL ADDRESSES THIS CRITICAL GAP BY DEVELOPING AND VALIDATING A NOVEL APPROACH TO ASSESS REAL-TIME PSYCHOLOGICAL AND PHYSIOLOGICAL PROCESSES AS MECHANISTIC DRIVERS OF REFRACTORY GERD SYMPTOMS. THE PROJECT WILL INTEGRATE ECOLOGICAL MOMENTARY ASSESSMENT (EMA), A METHOD OF CAPTURING REAL-TIME PSYCHOLOGICAL STATES, WITH 96-HOUR WIRELESS PH MONITORING, A CLINICAL TEST THAT CONTINUOUSLY RECORDS ACID REFLUX EVENTS AND SYMPTOM REPORTS. THIS COMBINED APPROACH ENABLES SIMULTANEOUS, REAL-WORLD MEASUREMENT OF PSYCHOLOGICAL AND PHYSIOLOGICAL PROCESSES AND THEIR DYNAMIC INTERPLAY IN SHAPING ESOPHAGEAL SYMPTOM PERCEPTION. AIM 1 WILL DEVELOP A PATIENT-CENTERED EMA TOOL TO CAPTURE RELEVANT PSYCHOLOGICAL PROCESSES IN GERD. AIM 2 WILL EVALUATE THE FEASIBILITY, ACCEPTABILITY, RELIABILITY, AND VALIDITY OF THE EMA TOOL AND ITS INTEGRATION WITH 96-HOUR WIRELESS PH MONITORING. AIM 3 WILL DETERMINE HOW PSYCHOLOGICAL PROCESSES AND REFLUX EVENTS INTERACT OVER TIME TO SHAPE SYMPTOM REPORTING, IDENTIFYING MECHANISTIC DRIVERS OF SYMPTOMS AND TARGETS FOR PRECISION BEHAVIORAL INTERVENTIONS. THIS PROPOSAL ALIGNS WITH A CAREER DEVELOPMENT PLAN DESIGNED TO SUPPORT DR. GUADAGNOLI IN BECOMING AN INDEPENDENT TRANSLATIONAL INVESTIGATOR. TRAINING GOALS INCLUDE BUILDING EXPERTISE IN ESOPHAGEAL PHYSIOLOGY AND PATHOGENESIS, GAINING COMPETENCY IN EMA METHODOLOGY AND IMPLEMENTATION, TRANSLATING MECHANISTIC FINDINGS INTO CLINICAL TARGETS FOR PRECISION-BASED INTERVENTIONS, AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT. MENTORSHIP WILL BE PROVIDED BY DR. JOHN PANDOLFINO (PRIMARY), DR. DOERTE JUNGHAENEL (CO-MENTOR), AND DR. LAUREN HEATHCOTE (CO-MENTOR), WITH GUIDANCE FROM AN INTERDISCIPLINARY TEAM OF CONSULTANTS, INCLUDING DRS. JACOB SCHAUER, SALVA BALBALE, AND KATHRYN TOMASINO. FINDINGS FROM THIS WORK WILL PROVIDE MECHANISTIC INSIGHTS INTO REFRACTORY GERD, INFORM FUTURE CLINICAL TRIALS, AND ADVANCE PRECISION-BASED TREATMENT STRATEGIES TARGETING BOTH CENTRAL AND PERIPHERAL DRIVERS OF ESOPHAGEAL SYMPTOMS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DRIVERS AND CONSEQUENCES OF MOVEMENT ANXIETY AFTER STROKE - PROJECT SUMMARY AFTER STROKE, MANY INDIVIDUALS UNDERUSE THEIR PARETIC UPPER EXTREMITY (UE) DESPITE SUFFICIENT MOTOR CAPACITY, LIMITING FUNCTIONAL RECOVERY. ONE POTENTIAL CAUSE OF UE UNDERUSE IS MOVEMENT ANXIETY—THE FEAR THAT MOVEMENT MAY WORSEN PAIN, CAUSE INJURY, OR TRIGGER RECURRENCE OF A MEDICAL EVENT. PREVIOUS STUDIES HAVE FOUND THAT 48– 83% OF STROKE PATIENTS EXPERIENCE MOVEMENT ANXIETY, BUT HAVE MAINLY FOCUSED ON WALKING AND BALANCE. MOVEMENT ANXIETY RELATING TO UE USE IS LESS WELL UNDERSTOOD, AND NO REHABILITATION INTERVENTIONS CURRENTLY TARGET THIS ISSUE. THIS GAP IN KNOWLEDGE LEAVES A POTENTIALLY MODIFIABLE BARRIER TO RECOVERY UNADDRESSED. IN THIS STUDY, WE WILL CLOSE THIS GAP BY PROSPECTIVELY TRACKING UE MOVEMENT ANXIETY IN SUBACUTE STROKE PATIENTS DURING INPATIENT REHABILITATION. WE WILL MEASURE MOVEMENT ANXIETY USING THE TAMPA SCALE OF KINESIOPHOBIA AND WILL CHARACTERIZE PATIENT AND REHABILITATION FACTORS USING CLINICAL SCALES AND THE ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORD. WE WILL ALSO USE WRIST-WORN ACCELEROMETERS TO MEASURE A 24-HOUR EPOCH OF SPONTANEOUS UE USE. IN AIM 1, WE WILL IDENTIFY PATIENT FACTORS THAT PREDICT HIGHER LEVELS OF MOVEMENT ANXIETY. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT UE PAIN WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONTRIBUTOR TO MOVEMENT ANXIETY, WITH PAIN CATASTROPHIZING A SECONDARY CONTRIBUTOR. IN AIM 2, WE WILL IDENTIFY PATIENT AND REHABILITATION FACTORS THAT INFLUENCE CHANGE IN MOVEMENT ANXIETY DURING THE INPATIENT REHABILITATION COURSE. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT REDUCTIONS IN UE PAIN AND PAIN CATASTROPHIZING WILL RELATE TO REDUCTIONS IN MOVEMENT ANXIETY. IN AIM 3, WE WILL DETERMINE THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN MOVEMENT ANXIETY AND UE USE. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT HIGHER MOVEMENT ANXIETY PREDICTS LOWER UE USE AND VICE VERSA. THE PROPOSED RESEARCH IS SIGNIFICANT BECAUSE IT WOULD IDENTIFY AT-RISK PATIENTS, GUIDE THE DEVELOPMENT OF TARGETED INTERVENTIONS, AND JUSTIFY THE NEED TO ADDRESS MOVEMENT ANXIETY IN REHABILITATION. THE PROPOSED RESEARCH IS INNOVATIVE BECAUSE IT EXAMINES A SURPRISINGLY UNDERSTUDIED PSYCHOLOGICAL CHALLENGE USING GOLD-STANDARD AND QUANTITATIVE METHODS. BY IDENTIFYING MOVEMENT ANXIETY AS A MODIFIABLE CONTRIBUTOR TO UE UNDERUSE, THIS STUDY LAYS THE GROUNDWORK FOR EARLY SCREENING AND TARGETED INTERVENTIONS TO ENHANCE REHABILITATION ENGAGEMENT AND RECOVERY. TO ACCOMPLISH THE PROPOSED WORK, DR. SHI HAS ASSEMBLED A MENTORING AND ADVISORY TEAM OF SEASONED INVESTIGATORS AND CLINICIANS WHO WILL OVERSEE HER CONCEPTUAL, TECHNICAL, AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT. IN ADDITION TO HER HANDS- ON RESEARCH EXPERIENCE, DR. SHI WILL UNDERTAKE TUTORIALS, COURSEWORK, AND SHADOWING TO BUILD HER KNOWLEDGE IN CLINICAL RESEARCH EXECUTION, TRANSLATING PSYCHOLOGICAL INSIGHTS INTO REHABILITATION, MOTION DATA CAPTURE AND PROCESSING, AND ADVANCED STATISTICAL ANALYSES. THIS ENHANCED SKILLSET WILL ENABLE DR. SHI TO INTEGRATE PSYCHOLOGICAL INSIGHTS INTO STROKE REHABILITATION, OPENING NEW THERAPEUTIC AVENUES TO ADVANCE THE FIELD OF NEUROREHABILITATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: ROLE OF B-CELLS IN SYSTEMIC SCLEROSIS-RELATED PULMONARY HYPERTENSION - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT PULMONARY HYPERTENSION (PH) IS A MAJOR DRIVER OF MORTALITY IN THE PATIENTS DIAGNOSED WITH SYSTEMIC SCLEROSIS (SSC). DESPITE BEING CONVENTIONALLY CLASSIFIED AS GROUP 1 PULMONARY ARTERIAL HYPERTENSION (PAH) BY THE WORLD SYMPOSIUM ON PH, THE BIOLOGY OF SSC-PH IS NOT THE SAME AS IDIOPATHIC PAH DESPITE TYPICALLY EXHIBITING PATTERNS OF PRE-CAPILLARY PH BY CARDIOPULMONARY HEMODYNAMICS. THERAPIES IN SSC-PH ARE LIMITED, MANY OF WHICH TARGET VASODILATION. TO UNCOVER NOVEL THERAPEUTIC APPROACHES, IT WILL BE NECESSARY TO GAIN A MORE DETAILED UNDERSTANDING INTO THE MECHANISMS AND MOLECULAR PATHWAYS OF SSC-PH. THE SCOPE OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO DETERMINE THE ROLE OF B-CELLS IN THE PATHOGENESIS SSC-PH. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT B-CELLS PROVIDE FURTHER ENDOTYPING NEEDED TO RISK STRATIFY PATIENTS WITH SSC-PH THROUGH THE FOLLOWING AIMS: 1) TEST WHETHER SSC PATIENTS WITH PRE-CAPILLARY PH HAVE INCREASED EFFECTOR B-CELL SUBSETS AND DIFFERENCES IN PATTERNS OF CYTOKINES AND AUTOANTIBODIES COMPARED TO THOSE WITHOUT; 2) DETERMINE THE DIFFERENTIAL B-CELL MRNA GENE EXPRESSION BETWEEN SSC PATIENTS WITH AND WITHOUT PRE-CAPILLARY PH; AND 3) DELINEATE A PATTERN OF B-CELL SUBSETS, CYTOKINES, AUTOANTIBODIES, AND MRNA GENE EXPRESSION PROFILE IN SSC PATIENTS WITH PRE- CAPILLARY PH WHO PROGRESS TO RIGHT VENTRICULAR DYSFUNCTION. THE OVERALL SIGNIFICANCE OF THIS WORK IS TO EVENTUALLY HELP GUIDE TREATMENT BY IDENTIFYING PATIENTS WHO MAY POTENTIALLY BENEFIT FROM B-CELL TARGETED APPROACHES TO THERAPY. THIS K23 AWARD, WITH THE COMBINED DIDACTICS, MENTORSHIP, AND RESEARCH EXPERIENCE IT AFFORDS WILL ME ADVANCE TOWARD MY CAREER GOAL OF BECOMING AN INDEPENDENT PHYSICIAN SCIENTIST. UPON COMPLETION OF THIS 5-YEAR CAREER DEVELOPMENT AWARD, I WILL HAVE CREATED THE FOUNDATION FOR A SUBSEQUENT R01 BY 1) EXPLORING THE B-CELL-SPECIFIC MECHANISTIC PATHWAYS IMPLICATED IN THE DEVELOPMENT AND PROGRESSION OF SSC-PH; AND 2) CREATING A DEEP ENDOTYPING OF THESE PATIENTS. OVER THE COURSE OF THIS PROPOSAL, I WILL BROADEN MY SKILLSET IN A) GENOMIC DATA MINING; B) DATA SCIENCE; C) BIOBANKING AND BIOREPOSITORY SCIENCE; D) IMMUNOPHENOTYPING; AND E) PROFICIENCY IN GRANT WRITING FOR INDEPENDENT RESEARCH FUNDING. OUR FINDINGS WILL PROVIDE THE RATIONALE FOR A MULTICENTER PROSPECTIVE STUDY TO CONFIRM B-CELL ENDOTYPES CHARACTERIZED IN PATIENTS WITH SSC-PH. THIS PROPOSED WORK ALIGNS WITH THE FOLLOWING GOALS OF THE NATIONAL HEART, LUNG, AND BLOOD INSTITUTE IN: 1) INVESTIGATING NEWLY DISCOVERED PATHOBIOLOGICAL MECHANISMS IMPORTANT TO THE ONSET AND PROGRESSION OF HEART, LUNG, BLOOD, AND SLEEP DISEASES; 2) IDENTIFYING FACTORS THAT ACCOUNT FOR INDIVIDUAL DIFFERENCES IN PATHOBIOLOGY AND TREATMENT RESPONSES; AND 3) LEVERAGING EMERGING OPPORTUNITIES IN DATA SCIENCE TO OPEN NEW FRONTIERS IN OF HEART, LUNG, BLOOD, AND SLEEP RESEARCH.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: SPACED TRANSCRANIAL DIRECT CURRENT STIMULATION FOR TREATMENT-RESISTANT DEPRESSION: A HOME-BASED RANDOMIZED SHAM-CONTROLLED TRIAL AND BIOMARKERS OF RESPONSE - PROJECT SUMMARY / ABSTRACT UP TO 55% OF PATIENTS WITH MAJOR DEPRESSIVE DISORDER (MDD) FAIL TO RESPOND TO STANDARD TREATMENTS AND PROGRESS TO TREATMENT-RESISTANT DEPRESSION (TRD). THE NEUROPLASTICITY DEFICIT HYPOTHESIS OF DEPRESSION—CENTERED ON DISRUPTED EXCITATORY AND INHIBITORY SIGNALING AND IMPAIRED SYNAPTIC REMODELING—OFFERS A COMPELLING FRAMEWORK FOR DEVELOPING NOVEL INTERVENTIONS. CURRENT INTERVENTIONAL PSYCHIATRY APPROACHES SUCH AS ELECTROCONVULSIVE THERAPY, KETAMINE, AND REPETITIVE TRANSCRANIAL MAGNETIC STIMULATION TARGET NEUROPLASTICITY BUT LACK SCALABILITY. TRANSCRANIAL DIRECT CURRENT STIMULATION (TDCS) HAS EMERGED AS A PROMISING ALTERNATIVE THAT IS SAFE, COST-EFFECTIVE, AND SUITABLE FOR REMOTE, HOME-BASED DELIVERY. HOWEVER, CLINICAL TRIALS USING CONVENTIONAL ONCE-DAILY TDCS PROTOCOLS IN TRD HAVE YIELDED MIXED RESULTS, LIKELY DUE TO SUBTHERAPEUTIC DOSING. OUR GROUP DEVELOPED A NOVEL “SPACED” TDCS PROTOCOL, INVOLVING MULTIPLE DAILY SESSIONS SEPARATED BY SHORT INTERVALS TO BETTER ENGAGE LATE- PHASE NEUROPLASTICITY, WHICH SHOWED PROMISING PRELIMINARY THERAPEUTIC EFFECTS. IN ADDITION TO IMPROVING THE EFFECTIVENESS AND SCALABILITY OF TDCS, THERE IS A CRITICAL NEED TO ELUCIDATE ITS NEUROPHYSIOLOGICAL MECHANISMS. TRANSCRANIAL MAGNETIC STIMULATION COMBINED WITH ELECTROENCEPHALOGRAPHY (TMS-EEG) ENABLES CAUSAL, REAL-TIME ASSESSMENT OF CORTICAL EXCITABILITY AND INHIBITION THROUGH TMS-EVOKED POTENTIALS. RESTING-STATE EEG (RSEEG) PROVIDES A COMPLEMENTARY, SCALABLE TOOL FOR ASSESSING LARGE-SCALE BRAIN NETWORK DYNAMICS AND HAS SHOWN PROMISE IN PREDICTING TREATMENT RESPONSE. WE PROPOSE A RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND SUPERIORITY TRIAL COMPARING ACTIVE VERSUS SHAM HOME-BASED SPACED TDCS IN 74 ADULTS WITH TRD. WE WILL USE TMS-EEG TO ASSESS CHANGES IN NEUROPLASTICITY, AS INDEXED BY CORTICAL EVOKED ACTIVITY (CEA), OVER THE DORSOLATERAL PREFRONTAL CORTEX (AIM 1). RSEEG METRICS, INCLUDING SPECTRAL POWER AND INTER-SITE PHASE CLUSTERING, WILL BE EXAMINED AS COMPLEMENTARY MARKERS OF LARGE-SCALE NETWORK PLASTICITY AND AS PREDICTORS OF TREATMENT RESPONSE (AIM 2). THE PRIMARY CLINICAL OUTCOME WILL BE CHANGE IN DEPRESSIVE SYMPTOMS MEASURED BY THE MONTGOMERY-ÅSBERG DEPRESSION RATING SCALE, TESTING THE HYPOTHESIS THAT ACTIVE SPACED TDCS IS SUPERIOR TO SHAM IN REDUCING DEPRESSION SEVERITY (AIM 3). THE APPLICANT’S CAREER DEVELOPMENT OBJECTIVES INCLUDE GAINING EXPERTISE IN NEUROPHYSIOLOGICAL BIOMARKER ACQUISITION AND ANALYSIS (TMS-EEG, RSEEG), ADVANCED TRAINING IN CLINICAL TRIAL DESIGN AND STATISTICAL METHODS, AND LAUNCHING AN INDEPENDENT RESEARCH PROGRAM FOCUSED ON BIOMARKER-INFORMED NEUROMODULATION STRATEGIES FOR TRD. THE APPLICANT WILL BE MENTORED BY DR. ZAFIRIS DASKALAKIS (CHAIR, UCSD PSYCHIATRY AND TMS-EEG EXPERT), WITH CO-MENTORSHIP FROM DR. ANDRÉ BRUNONI (TDCS TRIALIST) AND DR. LAWRENCE APPELBAUM (RSEEG EXPERT). CONSULTANT DR. XIN TU WILL PROVIDE GUIDANCE IN BIOSTATISTICS AND DATA MODELING. THE APPLICANT WILL DEVELOP THE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE NECESSARY TO BECOME AN INDEPENDENT INTERVENTIONAL PSYCHIATRY PHYSICIAN-SCIENTIST, AND HIS WORK WILL ADVANCE OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE MECHANISMS AND CLINICAL UTILITY OF SPACED HOME-BASED TDCS FOR TRD.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: BEYOND NEUROFILAMENT: ALS PROGNOSTICATION - PROJECT ABSTRACT THE SCIENTIFIC GOAL OF THIS K23 IS TO APPLY CUTTING-EDGE PROTEOMIC, GENOMIC, AND MACHINE-LEARNING ALGORITHMS TO DEFINE ALS BIOMARKERS THAT RESOLVE CLINICAL DIFFERENCES BETWEEN AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS (ALS) PATIENTS. WHILE IT HAS BEEN COMMONLY ACCEPTED THAT ALS IS A SINGLE DISEASE ENTITY, THERE IS NOW CONSIDERATION THAT IT IS, IN FACT, MULTIPLE DISEASES WITH DIFFERENT UNDERLYING MOLECULAR CAUSES. IF GENETIC AND PROTEOMIC DRIVERS OF CLINICAL VARIABILITY ARE IDENTIFIED, IT WILL BE POSSIBLE TO DEVELOP IMPROVED ALS BIOMARKER PANELS THAT CAN BE USED IN EVERYDAY CLINICAL PRACTICE AND TO IMPROVE ALS CLINICAL TRIAL DESIGN. THIS K23 APPLICATION PROPOSES A 5-YEAR TRAINING PROGRAM TO PROPEL DR. ELEANOR THOMAS TOWARDS HER CAREER AS A LEADER IN ALS BIOMARKER DISCOVERY AND CLINICAL APPLICATION. DR. THOMAS WILL ACCOMPLISH THIS GOAL WITH ADDITIONAL TRAINING IN (1) PROTEOMIC NETWORK ANALYSIS AND BIOINFORMATICS (2) ANALYSIS OF WHOLE GENOME SEQUENCING DATA AND (3) DATA SCIENCE, INCLUDING MACHINE LEARNING METHODS FOR PREDICTIVE MODELING. DR. THOMAS HAS OUTLINED AN INTEGRATIVE PROGRAM OF FORMAL COURSEWORK, HANDS-ON RESEARCH TRAINING, SEMINARS, CONFERENCES, AND CONSISTENT MENTORING FROM LEADING EXPERTS IN THE FIELDS OF ALS TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH (DR. JONATHAN GLASS), NEURODEGENERATION BIOMARKER DISCOVERY (DR. NICHOLAS SEYFRIED), ALS GENOMIC ANALYSIS (DR. JOHN LANDERS), AND BIOSTATISTICS AND DATA SCIENCE (DR. VICKI HERTZBERG). LEVERAGING THE UNIQUE CLINICAL RESOURCES HELD IN THE EMORY ALS CENTER DATABASE AND BIOBANK, DR. THOMAS WILL DEFINE ALS MOLECULAR SUBGROUPS THROUGH UNSUPERVISED CLUSTERING OF PLASMA PROTEOMIC DATA AND MAP THESE TO CLINICAL FEATURES, SUCH AS AGE OF ONSET, SITE OF ONSET AND PROGRESSION RATE (AIM 1). IN AIM 2 SHE WILL INTEGRATE WHOLE-GENOME SEQUENCING WITH PROTEOMIC DATA USING PROTEIN QUANTITATIVE TRAIT LOCI (PQTL) AND PROTEOME-WIDE ASSOCIATION STUDIES (PWAS) TO IDENTIFY GENETIC VARIANTS THAT REGULATE CIRCULATING PROTEIN ABUNDANCE AND INFLUENCE DISEASE TRAJECTORY. AIM 3 WILL DEVELOP AND VALIDATE A NEXT- GENERATION ALS SURVIVAL PREDICTION MODEL THAT COMBINES CLINICAL, PROTEOMIC, AND GENOMIC FEATURES TO ACHIEVE IMPROVED PROGNOSTIC ACCURACY. THIS WORK REPRESENTS THE LARGEST SINGLE-CENTER ALS PLASMA PROTEOMIC STUDY TO DATE AND THE LARGEST ALS PLASMA PQTL ANALYSIS. THE INTEGRATION OF PROTEOGENOMIC BIOMARKERS INTO ALS PROGNOSTIC MODELING WILL ENABLE PRECISE, INDIVIDUALIZED PREDICTION OF DISEASE PROGRESSION AND INFORM THE DESIGN OF FUTURE SUBTYPE-SPECIFIC CLINICAL TRIALS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DIFFERENTIATING THE EFFECTS OF DIRECT ELECTRICAL STIMULATION ON EPILEPTIFORM ACTIVITY IN THE HUMAN BRAIN - ABSTRACT DIRECT ELECTRICAL STIMULATION HAS BECOME A STANDARD OF MEDICATION-REFRACTORY EPILEPSY CARE FOR BOTH DIAGNOSTIC INVESTIGATION, VIA STIMULATION-INDUCED SEIZURE MAPPING IN PATIENTS UNDERGOING AN INTRACRANIAL EEG (IEEG) EPILEPSY MONITORING UNIT HOSPITAL STAY, AND THERAPEUTIC APPROACHES, VIA CHRONICALLY IMPLANTED NEUROSTIMULATION DEVICES. HOWEVER, THERAPEUTIC NEUROSTIMULATION DEVICES, WHICH WORK BY REDUCING EPILEPTIFORM ACTIVITY, OFTEN FAIL TO ACHIEVE SUSTAINED SEIZURE CONTROL IN A TIMELY AND CONTROLLED FASHION. THIS PROPOSAL INVESTIGATES HOW INDIVIDUAL, STRUCTURAL HUMAN BRAIN NETWORKS ENABLE NEUROSTIMULATION TO INDUCE, INHIBIT, AND TERMINATE EPILEPTIFORM ACTIVITY. A BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF NEUROSTIMULATION’S VARIED EFFECTS ON THE HUMAN BRAIN COULD HERALD NOVEL APPROACHES TO EPILEPSY NEUROSTIMULATION WITH RAPID, PREDICTABLE, AND CONSISTENT SEIZURE CONTROL. THIS K23 MENTORED PATIENT-ORIENTED RESEARCH CAREER DEVELOPMENT AWARD PROPOSAL OUTLINES A 5-YEAR TRAINING PROGRAM FOR THE MENTORED RESEARCHER TO GET TRAINING AND MENTORSHIP IN IEEG AND NEUROSTIMULATION. THE CANDIDATE’S 3-PART PROPOSAL SEEKS TO BETTER UNDERSTAND HOW NEUROSTIMULATION CAN INDUCE, INHIBIT, AND TERMINATE EPILEPTIFORM ACTIVITY. FIRST, THE CANDIDATE WILL ANALYZE THE SEIZURE CHARACTERISTICS OF PATIENTS WITH EPILEPSY IN THE IEEG EPILEPSY MONITORING UNIT WITH DIRECT ELECTRICAL STIMULATION TO INDUCE SEIZURES (AS PART OF STANDARD CLINICAL CARE) TO DETERMINE IF STRONGER BRAIN CONNECTIVITY, VIA WHITE MATTER CONNECTIONS SEEN ON DIFFUSION IMAGING, IS ASSOCIATED WITH GREATER INDUCTION OF TYPICAL SEIZURE TYPES. SECOND, THE CANDIDATE WILL PROSPECTIVELY STIMULATE THE THALAMUS OF PATIENTS WITH EPILEPSY IN THE IEEG EPILEPSY MONITORING UNIT, AT DIFFERENT FREQUENCIES AND DURATIONS, TO EXAMINE IF STRONGER BRAIN CONNECTIVITY WITH INHIBITORY STIMULATION IS ASSOCIATED WITH DECREASED EPILEPTIFORM ACTIVITY. THIRD, THE CANDIDATE WILL RETROSPECTIVELY EVALUATE IF PATIENTS WITH EPILEPSY AND CHRONICALLY, THALAMIC-IMPLANTED RESPONSIVE NEUROSTIMULATION DEVICES CAN UNDERGO WEAKER NEUROSTIMULATION TO TERMINATE SEIZURES AND IMPROVE SEIZURE CONTROL (SHORTER SEIZURE DURATION) WHEN THEY HAVE STRONGER BRAIN CONNECTIVITY. DURING THE K23, THE CANDIDATE WILL INVESTIGATE UNDERLYING STRUCTURAL BRAIN NETWORKS THAT DICTATE THE ABILITY OF NEUROSTIMULATION TO INDUCE, INHIBIT, AND TERMINATE EPILEPTIFORM ACTIVITY. THE CANDIDATE IS A BOARD-CERTIFIED NEUROLOGIST AND BOARD-CERTIFIED EPILEPTOLOGIST WITH A PRIOR MASTER’S DEGREE AND NIH-FUNDED TRAINING PRIMARILY IN NEUROIMAGING WITH SIGNIFICANT EXPERIENCE IN IEEG. THIS K23 WILL SERVE AS A STEPPINGSTONE TO DEVELOP THE CANDIDATE’S EXPERTISE IN IEEG AND NEUROSTIMULATION IN ANTICIPATION OF A FUTURE R01. AS THE YOUNG INVESTIGATOR TRANSITIONS FROM A MENTORED TO INDEPENDENT RESEARCH CAREER, THE CANDIDATE WILL COMPLETE COURSEWORK AND TRAINING IN NEURAL SIGNAL ANALYSIS TECHNIQUES, IMAGING ANALYSES, STATISTICS, MEDICAL DEVICES, AND CLINICAL TRIALS. THE CANDIDATE’S TRAINING WILL BE LED BY AN EXPERT MENTOR, WHO IS A LEADER IN THE FIELDS OF IEEG ANALYSIS, NEUROSTIMULATION, AND NEUROIMAGING, AND OVERSEEN BY A WORLD-CLASS TRAINING ADVISORY COMMITTEE WITH BACKGROUNDS IN EPILEPSY, MACHINE LEARNING, NEUROIMAGING, COMPUTATIONAL NEUROSCIENCE, AND NEUROSTIMULATION.

description: UNDERSTANDING THE IMPACT OF SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED INFECTIONS AND VAGINAL MICROBIOME IMBALANCE ON CERVICAL CANCER DEVELOPMENT IN MALI: IMPLICATIONS FOR NEW PREVENTION STRATEGIES - HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS (HPV) IS INDEED THE MOST COMMON SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED INFECTION (STIS) IN THE UNITED STATES (U.S.), WITH THE VAST MAJORITY OF SEXUALLY ACTIVE PEOPLE CONTRACTING AT LEAST ONE TYPE OF HPV IN THEIR LIFETIME. IN SUB- SAHARAN AFRICA (SSA), NEARLY ALL WOMEN LIVING WITH HIV WHO DEVELOP CERVICAL CANCER (CC) ARE CO-INFECTED WITH HPV (~99%) AND CC REMAINS ONE OF THE LEADING CAUSES OF CANCER-RELATED DEATHS AMONG WOMEN, WHERE THE BURDEN IS DISPROPORTIONATELY HIGH (~60% OF ALL CC CASES OCCUR IN THIS REGION), YET FEW OF THE ELIGIBLE WOMEN ARE SCREENED DESPITE FREE SERVICES. THIS MAKES MALI (A COUNTRY IN SSA) A VALUABLE SETTING FOR CONDUCTING SUCH RESEARCH AND FOR APPLYING LESSONS LEARNED TO BENEFIT U.S. AND GLOBAL HEALTH. WHILE MOST HPV INFECTIONS (80%-90%) ARE NATURALLY CLEARED BY THE HOST IMMUNE SYSTEM, PERSISTENT INFECTION WITH HIGH-RISK HPV (HRHPV) TYPES MARKEDLY INCREASES THE RISK OF ONCOGENIC PROGRESSION, ULTIMATELY LEADING TO INVASIVE CC. THIS PROGRESSION UNFOLDS OVER SEVERAL YEARS, PROVIDING A LONG WINDOW FOR PREVENTIVE MEASURES. CURRENTLY, THERE ARE NO APPROVED TREATMENTS TO DIRECTLY ELIMINATE HPV INFECTION, UNDERSCORING THE IMPORTANCE OF ADDRESSING AND MITIGATING THE FACTORS (E.G., CO-INFECTION WITH OTHER STIS) THAT PROMOTE HPV PERSISTENCE AS A KEY STRATEGY FOR CC PREVENTION AND CONTROL. RECENT STUDIES HIGHLY SUGGEST THAT CO-INFECTION WITH OTHER STIS (CO-STIS) MAY FACILITATE HPV PERSISTENCE AND ACCELERATE THE PROGRESSION TO CC. THESE FINDINGS HIGHLIGHT A CRUCIAL OPPORTUNITY TO DESIGN, TEST, AND IMPLEMENT INTEGRATED DUAL-SCREENING APPROACHES THAT DETECT AND ADDRESS BOTH HPV AND CO-STIS WITH APPROPRIATE TREATMENTS, AS A STRATEGY TO PREVENT PERSISTENCE OF HPV AND ULTIMATELY, CC. A BALANCED MICROBIOME, USUALLY DOMINATED BY LACTOBACILLUS SPECIES, HELPS SUSTAIN A PROTECTIVE ACIDIC ENVIRONMENT THAT INHIBITS THE GROWTH OF PATHOGENIC MICROORGANISMS AND REDUCES THE RISK OF STIS. ITS IMBALANCE HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH INCREASED SUSCEPTIBILITY TO STIS AND A GREATER LIKELIHOOD OF PERSISTENT HPV INFECTIONS. FOR THIS K43, WE SEEK TO CONDUCT A LONGITUDINAL COHORT STUDY, WHICH WILL INCLUDE BOTH HIV AND NON-HIV WOMEN, USING CLINICAL DATA, SELF-SAMPLED MICROBIOLOGY DIAGNOSTICS, AND METAGENOMIC ANALYSIS TO DETERMINE THE ROLE OF CO-STIS AND VAGINAL MICROBIOME IN HPV PERSISTENCE AND CERVICAL CARCINOGENESIS. WE WILL ALSO DEVELOP A PREDICTIVE FRAMEWORK TO GUIDE DUAL-SCREENING STRATEGIES, PREDICTIVE TOOLS, AND TARGETED PREVENTIVE INTERVENTIONS TAILORED TO CC CONTROL. THIS RESEARCH PROGRAM OVERALL ADDRESSES AN IMPORTANT EPIDEMIOLOGICAL GAP BY ADVANCING OUR UNDERSTANDING OF HOW CO-OCCURRING STIS AND VAGINAL MICROBIOME IMBALANCE CONTRIBUTE TO HRHPV PERSISTENCE AND CERVICAL CARCINOGENESIS, WHICH WILL BENEFIT WOMEN IN LOW-RESOURCE SETTINGS IN MALI, U.S., AND WORLDWIDE.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: INTERROGATING SELECTION OF AUTOREACTIVE T CELLS USING ISOGENIC HUMAN THYMIC ORGANOIDS - PROJECT SUMMARY TYPE 1 DIABETES (T1D) IS AN AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE THAT RESULTS IN THE DESTRUCTION OF INSULIN-PRODUCING PANCREATIC Β-CELLS, RENDERING THE T1D PATIENT DEPENDENT ON A CONTINUOUS SUPPLY OF EXOGENOUS INSULIN. INSULIN THERAPY IS A COMMON TREATMENT BUT DOES NOT PROVIDE A CURE. INDEED, INSULIN INJECTIONS AND INSULIN PUMPS CAN SUCCESSFULLY EXTEND LIFE EXPECTANCY, BUT PERSISTENT FLUCTUATIONS IN GLUCOSE LEVELS CAN RESULT IN LIFE-THREATENING COMPLICATIONS INCLUDING EPISODES OF HYPOGLYCEMIA, CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE, NEUROPATHY, AND RENAL FAILURE. MANY ATTEMPTS TO CIRCUMVENT THE AUTOIMMUNE RESPONSE UNDERLYING T1D HAVE UTILIZED BROAD, NON-SPECIFIC IMMUNE SUPPRESSION, WHICH CAN TEMPORARILY SLOW THE PROGRESSION OF DISEASE IN NEWLY DIAGNOSED INDIVIDUALS, BUT NONE HAVE DEMONSTRATED CLINICAL REMISSION OR EVEN ANY OVERT EFFECT ON DISEASE COURSE LONG TERM. THE ESTABLISHMENT OF IMMUNE SELF-TOLERANCE REQUIRES THE SYNERGY OF TWO DIFFERENT SYSTEMS, CENTRAL TOLERANCE IN THE THYMUS AND PERIPHERAL TOLERANCE IN THE TISSUES, THAT WORK IN CONCERT TO PREVENT AUTOIMMUNITY. DEFICIENCIES IN PERIPHERAL TOLERANCE ARE MORE WIDELY STUDIED AND HAVE BEEN CORRELATED WITH HUMAN AUTOIMMUNE DISORDERS INCLUDING T1D. YET, ATTEMPTS TO RENEW SELF-TOLERANCE MECHANISMS IN THE PERIPHERY HAVE DISPLAYED ONLY MODEST, IF ANY, IMPACT ON DISEASE PROGRESSION. THESE DATA SUGGEST THAT OVERCOMING THE INITIAL BREAKDOWN IN CENTRAL TOLERANCE IS KEY TO PREVENTING AUTOIMMUNITY. HOWEVER, THE MECHANISMS GOVERNING CENTRAL TOLERANCE THAT CONTRIBUTE TO OR INFLUENCE T1D ONSET ARE STILL LARGELY UNKNOWN, FOREMOST DUE TO THE ABSENCE OF HUMAN SYSTEMS THAT CAN BE USED TO INTERROGATE SELECTION PROCESSES IN A MATCHED MANNER. THE DEVELOPMENT OF PROTOCOLS IN OUR LAB AS WELL AS OTHERS TO INDUCE THE IN VITRO DIFFERENTIATION OF HUMAN PLURIPOTENT STEM CELL (HPSC)-DERIVED THYMIC CELLS (STC) FOLLOWED BY IN VITRO CULTURE OF HUMAN THYMIC ORGANOIDS OR TRANSPLANTATION OF STC INTO THYMUS-DEFICIENT MICE HAVE OPENED THE DOOR FOR INNOVATIVE APPROACHES TO ANSWERING THESE PRESSING QUESTIONS. IN THIS PROPOSAL, I HYPOTHESIZE LOW AFFINITY TCR AUTOREACTIVE T CELLS WILL ESCAPE THE SELECTION PROCESS, ULTIMATELY ALLOWING FOR Β-CELL-REACTIVE T CELLS TO PERSIST, WHILE HIGH AFFINITY TCRS WILL BE REMOVED OR DIVERTED TO THE TREG FATE. TO TEST THIS HYPOTHESIS, THE FOLLOWING INDEPENDENT BUT INTERRELATED AIMS USING HUMAN ISOGENIC SYSTEMS WILL BE PERFORMED: (1) DETERMINE HOW AUTOREACTIVE TCR AFFINITY INFLUENCES HUMAN THYMIC T CELL SELECTION, AND (2) EVALUATE THE FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCES OF AUTOREACTIVE TCR AFFINITY ON Β-CELL REACTIVITY. COLLECTIVELY, GENETIC ENGINEERING OF STEM CELL-DERIVED THYMIC CELLS AND T CELL PROGENITORS TO DEVELOP ISOGENIC THYMIC ORGANOIDS OR NOVEL IN VIVO HUMANIZED SYSTEMS WILL PROVIDE KEY INSIGHTS INTO CELLULAR TOLERANCE MECHANISMS IN HUMAN T1D, ADDRESSING A CRITICAL NEED IN THE T1D FIELD. COMPLETION OF THESE STUDIES MAY ALSO ILLUMINATE NOVEL TARGETS FOR T1D INTERVENTION OR TREATMENT, ALLOWING US TO UNDERSTAND AND GENERATE PATIENT-DERIVED POLYCLONAL THYMUS EDUCATED REGULATORY T CELL POOLS OR DIVERSE T CELL REPERTOIRES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A CORTEX-MIDBRAIN CIRCUIT REGULATES ENERGY BALANCE - PROJECT SUMMARY OBESITY PREVALENCE IS A GROWING PROBLEM AROUND THE WORLD. WHILE TREATMENTS ARE IMPROVING, THEY ARE NOT KEEPING UP WITH THE GROWING RATE OF OBESITY. ONE OF THE REASONS THIS IS THE CASE IS DUE TO THE LACK OF UNDERSTANDING IN HOW APPETITE, FOOD CONSUMPTION, AND ENERGY EXPENDITURE ARE REGULATED BY THE BRAIN. ONE OF THE MAJOR CONTRIBUTORS OF APPETITE REGULATION INCLUDES BRAIN-DERIVED SEROTONIN (5-HT), WHICH IS SYNTHESIZED PRIMARILY IN THE DORSAL RAPHE NUCLEUS (DRN). 5-HTDRN NEURONS HAVE BEEN WELL ESTABLISHED TO REGULATE APPETITE, FOOD CONSUMPTION AND ENERGY EXPENDITURE. HOWEVER, A GAP IN THE RESEARCH WHICH FOCUSES ON UPSTREAM INPUTS TO 5-HTDRN NEURONS REMAINS. ONE UNDERSTUDIED UPSTREAM NUCLEUS WHICH PROJECTS TO 5-HTDRN NEURONS IS THE AGRANULAR INSULAR CORTEX (AIC). THE AIC IS A MAJOR INTEROCEPTIVE HUB OF THE BRAIN THAT PROCESS FOOD CUES AND HAS BEEN IMPLICATED TO RESPOND TO BOTH WEIGHT GAIN AND WEIGHT LOSS IN HUMANS. CONSISTENTLY, EVIDENCE FROM A FEW ANIMAL STUDIES INDICATE THAT THE AIC CONTRIBUTES TO FOOD CUE PROCESSING. NO ANIMAL STUDIES HAVE FOCUSED ON 5-HTDRN-PROJECTING AIC NEURONAL REGULATION OF APPETITE, FOOD CONSUMPTION, ENERGY HOMEOSTASIS, AND BEHAVIOR. TOGETHER, THESE FINDINGS LED TO A CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS THAT AIC PROJECTIONS TO 5-HTDRN NEURONS PLAY A CRITICAL ROLE IN ENERGY HOMEOSTASIS. THE FOCUS OF THIS PROPOSAL WILL REVEAL THAT ACTIVATION OF AIC→DRN CIRCUIT PROVIDES A “PHYSIOLOGICAL SIGNAL” TO COORDINATE ENERGY BALANCE WITH INTERNAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL CUES AND WILL REVEAL THE IDENTITY OF AIC NEURONS WHICH PROJECT TO THE DRN. FURTHER, I WILL DETERMINE THE ROLE OF 5-HTDRN NEURONS IN MEDIATING THE EFFECTS OF THE AIC ON ENERGY BALANCE. THESE OBJECTIVES WILL BE ACHIEVED BY VIRALLY ACTIVATING OR INHIBITING THE AIC→DRN CIRCUIT TO STUDY THE IMPACT ON BODY WEIGHT, FEEDING, BODY COMPOSITION, METABOLISM, AND BROWN ADIPOSE TISSUE (BAT) THERMOGENESIS, AT VARIED ENVIRONMENTAL TEMPERATURES, IN ANXIOGENIC ENVIRONMENTS, AND IN DIFFERENT HUNGER STATES. FURTHERMORE, I WILL LEARN FIBER PHOTOMETRY TO DETERMINE THE AIC→DRN NEURONAL ACTIVITY AND CORRESPONDING BAT ACTIVITY DURING THE DIFFERENT STAGES OF FEEDING IN DIFFERENT HUNGER STATES, DURING STRESS, AND WITH COLD EXPOSURE. I WILL ALSO CONDUCT SINGLE NUCLEI RNASEQ IN LEFT AND RIGHT AIC→DRN NEURONS TO DETERMINE THEIR IDENTITY. FINALLY, I WILL USE A NOVEL COMBINATION OF VIRAL AND GENETIC TECHNIQUES TO ISOLATE THE ROLE OF AIC→5-HTDRN NEURONS SPECIFICALLY USING ELECTROPHYSIOLOGY AND FIBER PHOTOMETRY. WITH SUPPORT FROM THIS OPPORTUNITY, I WILL UTILIZE THE MENTORED PHASE TO EXPAND MY EXPERTISE SO THAT I CAN ADVANCE AND LEARN MORE NOVEL AND COMPREHENSIVE METHODS TO STUDY THE AIC→5-HTDRN CIRCUIT AND ENERGY HOMEOSTASIS. THIS OPPORTUNITY WILL PROVIDE ME WITH THE NECESSARY TOOLS TO ENHANCE MY TRAINING AND TRANSITION INTO MY CAREER AS AN INDEPENDENT RESEARCH SCIENTIST AT AN ACADEMIC INSTITUTION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEFINING REGULATORS OF POLYCYSTIN-2 CILIARY TRAFFICKING - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT POLYCYSTIN-2 (PC2) IS ONE OF THE KEY PROTEINS, WHOSE MUTATION IS RESPONSIBLE FOR MANY CASES OF AUTOSOMAL DOMINANT POLYCYSTIC KIDNEY DISEASE (ADPKD). ALTHOUGH PC2 HAS LONG BEEN OBSERVED IN PRIMARY CILIA—AND IT IS WIDELY ACCEPTED THAT CILIARY LOCALIZATION IS ESSENTIAL FOR PC2 FUNCTION—THE MOLECULAR MECHANISM THAT GOVERNS PC2 ENTRY INTO, AND RETENTION WITHIN CILIA REMAINS POORLY DEFINED. PROGRESS HAS BEEN GREATLY LIMITED BY THE LACK OF ROBUST TOOLS FOR IN VIVO, LIVE-CELL IMAGING OF ENDOGENOUS PC2 WITHOUT OVEREXPRESSION ARTIFACTS. IN THE FIRST PART OF MY POSTDOCTORAL TRAINING, I DEVELOPED A PKD2-HALOTAG KNOCK-IN MOUSE MODELS, THAT ALLOWED ME TO INVESTIGATE ENDOGENOUS PC2 LOCALIZATION, DYNAMICS, COMPLEX FORMATION, AND TURNOVER DURING HOMEOSTASIS AND DISEASE STATUS IN LIVE AND FIXED MATERIALS. USING THIS MODEL, I GENERATED WIDE-TYPE PKD2-HALOTAG CELL LINE WITH NORMAL CILIARY PC2 LOCALIZATION, AND MULTIPLE MUTANT CELL LINES THAT REPRODUCIBLY LOSE PC2 CILIARY TRAFFICKING VIA CRISPR/CAS9 TECHNIQUES. WITH THESE RESOURCES, THE GOAL OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO IDENTIFY NOVEL REGULATOR PROTEINS THAT GOVERN THE TRAFFICKING AND RETENTION OF PC2 IN THE PRIMARY CILIA. AIM 1 WILL DISCOVER NOVEL REGULATORS OF PC2 CILIARY TRAFFICKING BY COMPARING NATIVE PC2 COMPLEXES FROM CELLS LINES THAT ARE EITHER COMPETENT OR DEFECTIVE FOR PC2 CILIARY LOCALIZATION, USING QUANTITATIVE AND SUBTRACTIVE INTERACTOMICS. BONA FIDE REGULATORS WILL BE PRIORITIZED AND VALIDATED USING A STANDARDIZED FRAMEWORK EXEMPLIFIED BY CEP290, WHICH IS TRANSITION-ZONE SCAFFOLD PROTEIN EMERGING FROM PILOT MASS SPECTROMETRY DATASETS AND FROM EVIDENCE GENERATED FROM CEP290 MUTANT PATIENT FIBROBLASTS. AIM 2 WILL EXAMINE THE FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCES OF DISRUPTED PC2 TRAFFICKING OR CILIARY RETENTION ON CYSTOGENESIS IN A HUMAN-RELEVANCE 3D KIDNEY ORGANOID MODEL DERIVED FROM IPSC CARRYING THE ENDOGENOUS PKD2-HALOTAG ALLELE. I WILL TEST TWO CAUSAL QUESTIONS: (1) WHETHER DELETION OF A GIVEN REGULATOR IMPAIRS PC2 CILIARY TRAFFICKING IN ORGANOIDS, AND (II) WHETHER SUCH TRAFFICKING FAILURE IS SUFFICIENT TO INITIATE OR ACCELERATE CYST FORMATION. TOGETHER, THESE STUDIES WILL DELINEATE THE TRAFFICKING STEPS THAT DELIVER AND ANCHOR PC2 IN CILIA AND DETERMINE HOW THEIR FAILURE INITIATES CYSTOGENESIS. CAREER DEVELOPMENT: THE K99 PHASE, CONDUCTED IN THE LABORATORY OF DR. BRADLEY K. YODER WITH CO-MENTORSHIP FROM DR. CHENG “JACK” SONG AT UAB, WILL PROVIDE RIGOROUS TRAINING IN ADVANCED BIOCHEMISTRY, QUANTITATIVE INTERACTOMICS, HIGH-RESOLUTION IMAGING, AND HUMAN KIDNEY ORGANOID BIOLOGY. THE DETAILED TRAINING PLAN INTEGRATES FORMAL COURSEWORK, MENTORED PRACTICE IN EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN AND DATA ANALYSIS, AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN RESEARCH RIGOR, GRANT WRITING, AND LAB LEADERSHIP, WITH ADDITIONAL SUPPORTS FROM THE ADVISORY COMMITTEE. THE SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT WILL POSITION ME TO LAUNCH AN INDEPENDENT RESEARCH PROGRAM FOCUSED ON THE MECHANISMS OF PC2 CILIARY TRAFFICKING AND ON TARGETING PC2 TRAFFICKING FOR DISEASE-MODIFYING THERAPY IN ADPKD.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: INVESTIGATING THE GENETIC MODULATION OF PHENOTYPIC AND TRANSCRIPTOMIC CONVERGENCE IN BIPOLAR DISORDER AND SCHIZOPHRENIA - ABSTRACT SCHIZOPHRENIA (SCZ) AND BIPOLAR DISORDER (BD) ARE SEVERE PSYCHIATRIC CONDITIONS THAT AFFECT OVER 2% OF THE GLOBAL POPULATION, LEADING TO SIGNIFICANT DISABILITY, REDUCED LIFE EXPECTANCY, AND A HEAVY SOCIOECONOMIC BURDEN. GENETIC STUDIES HAVE ADVANCED OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE FACTORS CONTRIBUTING TO THESE DISORDERS, BUT MOST RESEARCH HAS BEEN CONDUCTED ON POPULATIONS OF FEW ANCESTRIES, LEAVING MAJOR GAPS IN HOW SCZ AND BD MANIFEST IN COMPREHENSIVE POPULATIONS. UNDERSTANDING THE GENETIC ARCHITECTURE OF THESE DISORDERS ACROSS MINIMALLY CHARACTERIZED GROUPS IS CRUCIAL FOR DEVELOPING MORE BROADLY APPLICABLE PRECISION MEDICINE APPROACHES. IN THIS RESEARCH PROPOSAL, I AIM TO INVESTIGATE THE GENETIC AND BIOLOGICAL CONVERGENCE OF SCZ AND BD BY LEVERAGING LARGE-SCALE DATASETS THAT INCLUDE MULTI-OMICS DATA—GENOMICS, TRANSCRIPTOMICS, AND CLINICAL DATA FROM COMPREHENSIVE AND UNIQUE POPULATIONS. SPECIFICALLY, I WILL (1) EVALUATE THE TRANSCRIPTIONAL CONVERGENCE OF SCZ AND BD GENES USING SINGLE-CELL RNA SEQUENCING (SCRNA-SEQ) DATA FROM NEURONS; (2) EXPLORE HOW RARE GENETIC VARIANTS IN SCZ AND BD IMPACT PHENOTYPIC COMORBIDITIES AND CONVERGENCE BY EXAMINING CLINICAL TRAJECTORIES AND COMORBIDITIES IN INDIVIDUALS USING LONGITUDINAL ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORDS (EHRS); AND (3) EXTEND MY PRIOR WORK DEVELOPING THE GISMO EVOLUTIONARY CONSTRAINT METRIC TO NONCODING REGIONS THROUGH GISMO-REG, ENABLING SYSTEMATIC PRIORITIZATION OF REGULATORY ELEMENTS INTOLERANT TO DISRUPTION, AND PERFORMING RARE VARIANT BURDEN ANALYSES WITHIN THESE ELEMENTS TO IDENTIFY CONVERGENT NONCODING RISK FACTORS. TOGETHER, THESE AIMS WILL REVEAL KEY MOLECULAR, REGULATORY, AND CLINICAL PATHWAYS SHARED BETWEEN SCZ AND BD WHILE CLARIFYING DISORDER-SPECIFIC DIFFERENCES, PROVIDING A FOUNDATION FOR MORE PRECISE PSYCHIATRIC DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT. THIS PROJECT WILL BE LED BY DR. CALWING (CAL) LIAO, A STATISTICAL GENETICIST WITH EXPERTISE IN PSYCHIATRIC GENETICS, MULTI-OMIC DATA INTEGRATION, AND THE ANALYSIS OF RARE VARIANTS. DR. LIAO HAS DEVELOPED A COMPREHENSIVE RESEARCH PLAN TO COMPLETE THESE AIMS WHILE ADVANCING HIS CAREER DEVELOPMENT THROUGH TRAINING IN ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORD ANALYSIS, SINGLE-CELL TRANSCRIPTOMICS, AND PSYCHIATRIC GENOMICS IN COMPREHENSIVE POPULATIONS. THIS WILL SUPPORT HIS LONG-TERM GOAL OF BECOMING AN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR WHO INTEGRATES MULTI-OMIC AND GENETIC DATA TO UNCOVER THE MOLECULAR UNDERPINNINGS OF COMPLEX PSYCHIATRIC DISORDERS SUCH AS SCZ AND BD. DR. LIAO’S EXCEPTIONAL ADVISORY TEAM WILL DIRECTLY SUPPORT HIS CAREER DEVELOPMENT. HIS PRIMARY MENTOR, DR. BEN NEALE, IS A LEADER IN PSYCHIATRIC GENETICS AND LARGE-SCALE GENETIC ANALYSIS. ADDITIONAL ADVISORY TEAM MEMBERS INCLUDE EXPERTS IN BIOSTATISTICS, FUNCTIONAL GENOMICS, AND PSYCHIATRIC PHENOTYPING, PROVIDING CRITICAL GUIDANCE ACROSS THE RESEARCH AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT OBJECTIVES. DR. LIAO’S ADVISORY TEAM, COMBINED WITH THE COLLABORATIVE AND RESOURCE-RICH ENVIRONMENT AT THE BROAD INSTITUTE OF MIT AND HARVARD, WILL ENSURE HIS SUCCESSFUL TRANSITION TO AN INDEPENDENT RESEARCH CAREER IN PSYCHIATRIC GENETICS.
